known_regression: Original bad decision must be rejected. Exact failing 8-article batch with all 6 prior accepted runs replayed in both arms, no edited decisions. A single original Oct6 cat article then follows each accepted replay, preserving its cat story identity and remaining separate from the ship. This is a composed continuation, not the full original Oct6 feed.

fixed_context_adapter: Fresh cases use hits_per_article=10 to include all designated source cards from unedited common model-generated prehistory.
